skill.name: meeting-minutes-assistant
skill.description: Organizes meeting recordings or text notes into structured minutes, action items, owners, and follow-up tracking.
skill.summary: Turn meeting records into clear minutes with decisions, tasks, owners, and follow-up notes.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a high-entropy heuristic on SKILL.md. Manual review shows the file is readable Markdown with Chinese text and metadata, not binary, encrypted, or obfuscated content.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.21 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is readable Markdown with YAML front matter, Chinese description text, and simple usage notes. No encoded payload, encrypted content, executable code, or prompt injection text was found.

content.value_statement: Meeting records often lose decisions, owners, and next steps. This skill converts supplied meeting content into structured minutes and follow-up tasks.
actual_capabilities: Structures supplied meeting records into organized minutes.
Extracts decisions, action items, owners, and due dates when present.
Creates follow-up tracking sections for team accountability.
Supports conversational use in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
Reminds users to manually review important outputs.
limitations: It does not include a dedicated audio transcription engine.
It needs source text, notes, or accessible meeting content from the user.
It cannot verify names, dates, or commitments against external systems.
Human review is required before sharing official minutes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Weekly Team Minutes
use_cases.description: Convert a transcript or rough notes into concise minutes with decisions and next steps.

use_cases.title: Track Executive Action Items
use_cases.description: Extract owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions from leadership meeting notes.

use_cases.title: Summarize Client Calls
use_cases.description: Create a professional recap that lists commitments, open issues, and follow-up tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Meeting Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a clean summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create meeting minutes from these notes. Include agenda, key discussion points, decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines.

prompt_templates.title: Action Item Tracker
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this meeting transcript and build a follow-up list. Group tasks by owner and flag missing deadlines or unclear responsibilities.

prompt_templates.title: Client Recap
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this client call record into a concise recap. Include agreed decisions, client requests, internal next steps, and items needing confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Decision And Risk Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this meeting record for decisions, unresolved risks, dependencies, and follow-up owners. Separate confirmed facts from items that need verification.

output_examples.input: Notes from a sprint planning meeting with tasks, blockers, and owners.
output_examples.output: Meeting minutes include the sprint goal, selected work, key decisions, action items by owner, blockers, and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Transcript from a client status call about launch timing.
output_examples.output: The recap lists client concerns, agreed launch actions, responsible teams, due dates mentioned in the call, and points needing confirmation.

output_examples.input: Rough notes from a leadership review.
output_examples.output: The summary separates strategic decisions, open risks, assigned follow-ups, and items that require executive approval.

best_practices: Provide clear speaker names, dates, and meeting context when available.
Ask for decisions and action items to be separated in the output.
Review sensitive or official minutes before sharing them.
anti_patterns: Do not use unclear notes and expect accurate owners or deadlines.
Do not publish generated minutes without checking important details.
Do not include confidential meeting content without proper permission.

faq.question: Can this skill transcribe audio files?
faq.answer: The skill description mentions recordings, but the package does not include a transcription engine. Provide text when direct audio processing is unavailable.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it identify action item owners?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract owners when the meeting content clearly states them.

faq.question: Does it verify deadlines?
faq.answer: No. It can report deadlines from the source content, but users should verify them.

faq.question: Is it suitable for client meetings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create concise recaps, commitments, and follow-up items for client communication.

faq.question: Should official minutes be reviewed?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill file advises human review for important AI-assisted output.
